primary_diagnosis: Keng tarqalgan blyashkali psoriaz, o'rtacha-og'ir bosqich

pasi_assessment.recommendation: Biologik terapiya (Sekukinumab / Anti-IL-17A) yoki tizimli immunosupressantlar + NB-UVB fototerapiya.

selected_biologic.indication: O'rta va og'ir darajadagi blyashkali psoriaz (PASI > 10)
selected_biologic.administration: Teri ostiga (Combopack 2x150mg yoki 1x300mg avto-shprits). Induksiya: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4-haftalarda, so'ngra har 4 haftada 1 marta.

steroid_tapering_schedule.title: 1-Hafta: Kundalik Boshqaruv & Barer Tiklash
steroid_tapering_schedule.morning: Kuchli steroid malham (Klobetazol/Betametazon) - faqat blyashka ustiga yupqa qilib
steroid_tapering_schedule.clinical_goal: O'tkir yallig'lanish va qizarishni tezda pasaytirish.

steroid_tapering_schedule.title: 2-Hafta: Dozani 50% Kamaytirish (Kun Oraliq)
steroid_tapering_schedule.morning: Dushanba/Chorshanba/Juma: Steroid malham; Boshqa kunlari: Takrolimus 0.1% malham
steroid_tapering_schedule.clinical_goal: Teri atrofiyasining oldini olish va terini gormonga qaramligini uzish.

steroid_tapering_schedule.title: 3-Hafta: Reboundga Qarshi 'Dam Olish Kunlari' Rejimi
steroid_tapering_schedule.morning: Faqat Shanba va Yakshanba: Steroid malham; Hafta ichi: FAQAT Takrolimus 0.1%
steroid_tapering_schedule.clinical_goal: Gormonni to'xtatganda qizarish qayta 'portlashi' (rebound flare) to'sig'i.

steroid_tapering_schedule.title: 4-Hafta: To'liq Gormonsiz Proaktiv Terapiya
steroid_tapering_schedule.clinical_goal: 100% gormonsiz remissiya va terining lipid qoplamini mustahkamlash.

clinical_rules: 1. Biologik preparatni qabul qilishdan oldin Mantoux/Diaskintest (tuberkulyoz) va gepatit B/C tekshiruvi shart.
2. Sovuq zanjir (+2°C..+8°C) buzilsa, oqsil molekulalari parchalanadi va samarasiz bo'ladi.
3. Gormonli malhamlarni to'satdan tashlab yubormang; 4-haftalik sekin tushirish jadvaliga amal qiling.
4. NB-UVB 311 nm fototerapiyasi seansidan 2 soat oldin quyoshdan saqlovchi krem surtmang.
5. Har kuni cho'milgandan so'ng dastlabki 3 daqiqada teri namligini saqlash uchun seramidli emollient surting.
